name: Ladder-Assisted Elevated Access
description: Access points above ground level — second-floor windows, roof hatches, elevated loading docks, mechanical rooms — may be accessible via ladder when ground-level entry points are hardened. A telescoping ladder is compact enough to transport covertly and can be deployed quickly against a building exterior. Elevated access opens roof-level opportunities for implant placement, antenna installation, and HVAC duct access.

blue.det: Highly visible — individual with ladder near building exterior; camera footage; neighbor or passerby reports.
blue.cm: Camera coverage of building exterior including elevated access points; anti-climb features on drainpipes and facades; motion-triggered lighting; patrol checking perimeter including elevated areas.
